contentText: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella on Thursday faced new accusations of having made anti-Semitic remarks as a teenager, after French media published extracts from previously unaired conversations online. The 31-year-old top ally of French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has denied any wrongdoing after allegations emerged in September that he made conspiracist comments about Jewish people on Facebook in 2013. FRANCE 24's Solange Mougin reports.
